messages:
clair: Quick repro for onboarding hang: run examples/gen --stream --rotate-auth=3s and you'll see gen.Next() never returns after a refresh.

yosuke: can you paste the stack?

clair: stack shows recvLoop stuck on chan receive. logs: 
```
INFO gen: stream start
DEBUG auth: refresh started
WARN runtime: handshake retry
ERROR gen: unauthenticated
<-- main blocked on gen.Next() -->
```

sam: UX issue: Next() has no context. other SDKs expose cancelable pulls. options: add Next(ctx) or make SDK auto-abort on fatal handshake. adding Next(ctx) preserves parity and is least surprising.

yosuke: agree. implement Next(ctx) and keep Next() as sugar calling Next(context.Background()). also make Close() idempotent and safe concurrently.

clair: short-term workaround: run Next() in goroutine and call gen.Close() on ctx.Done(). ugly but works.

dev-bot: created issue #9201: "go gen: add ctx-aware Next to avoid mid-stream hang". Please link PR when ready.
